svg.title: Stable selection, one row at a time
svg.desc: Scores for experts 0 through 5 are 0.2, 0.9, 0.9, -1.0, 0.7, and 0.1. With k=2, return indices 1 and 2. Equal scores keep increasing original index order. The full stable order is 1, 2, 4, 0, 5, 3.

g.aria-label: Stable selection, one row at a time
Ties use the smaller index first.
